title: Focused Cavity Initialization with Neighbor Coupling Penalty
scientific_hypothesis: Centering the defect cavity layer (layer 11, index 10) at ~295 nm with bounded variance ±25 nm, combined with a neighboring-layer coupling penalty (weight 0.05), will improve numerical convergence and target score by refining the search into the viable resonance manifold identified in route_03.
design_principle: Modified quarter-wave HCDC stack with defect cavity at layer 11; cavity thickness initialized near half-wave optical thickness at 1350 nm center wavelength; coupling penalty discourages discontinuous thickness jumps between cavity and adjacent mirror layers.
proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2/SiO2)_5 | HfO2_cavity | (SiO2/HfO2)_5 | Fused Silica substrate; exactly 21 finite layers with layer 11 (index 10) as HfO2 defect cavity
design_variables: cavity layer thickness centered at 295 nm ±25 nm
manufacturing_considerations: HfO2/SiO2 compatible with electron beam evaporation
Cavity layer thickness control critical for resonance
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for planar multilayer interference
Defect cavity resonance in photonic bandgap structures
Quarter-wave stack building blocks with modified cavity layer
expected_advantages: Focused initialization reduces search space volume
Coupling penalty promotes physically realistic thickness transitions
Should improve convergence over broad stochastic sampling
known_risks: May converge to local optimum near initialization point
Coupling penalty weight may be too restrictive if 0.05 is excessive
Numerical convergence issues may persist if optimizer settings unchanged
execution_request_english: Design a 21-layer defect-cavity dielectric stack on fused silica substrate using HfO2 and SiO2. Stack topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2_cavity | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica. Layer 11 (index 10, HfO2 cavity) thickness initialization: center at 295 nm with variance ±25 nm. Apply neighboring-layer coupling penalty with weight 0.05 between layers 9-10-11 to discourage discontinuous thickness jumps. Optimize all 21 layer thicknesses for maximum transmission in 1000-1700 nm and maximum reflection in 300-450 nm at normal incidence. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with convergence tolerance tightened to address numerical convergence issues. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: center cavity layer 11 at 295nm ±25nm instead of broad stochastic sampling; add neighbor coupling penalty weight 0.05 between layers 9-10-11
